_comment: Facts about this adapter that its probe response cannot carry: display names, maturity, and the engine versions CI actually restores from. Everything the probe declares (adapter version, engine id, source kinds, pitr) is read from testdata/probe_response.golden instead — never duplicated here. The images below are the official CouchDB ones; the sandbox needs no wrapper, because they already carry a POSIX shell and curl, which is everything the adapter drives the engine with (measured 2026-08-30). The baseline is the 3.5 line, the current one, with 3.4 beside it. See docs/capabilities.md and docs/engine-versions.md.
name: CouchDB

sources.couchdb_data_tar: A tar of CouchDB's data directory
sources.couchdb_data: One copy of CouchDB's data directory — the tree holding `_dbs.couch`, `_nodes.couch` and `shards/`
sources.couchbackup: One `couchbackup` file: its header line, then one JSON batch of documents per line
sources.couchbackup_dir: A directory of them; the newest by file time is restored (no CouchDB artifact records when it was taken)
